args.prompt:
Create ONE new KFB Slop character asset sheet: exactly SIX unique absurd-surreal, emotionally expressive INK BLOB MONSTERS in a landscape 3 columns x 2 rows grid, transparent PNG, target1536x1024. These are modest everyday residents of HyperNorm apartment buildings, not heroes or humans. Theme: emotions and ambivalent social habits, tender dry satirical neighbor humor. No scenelets, text, labels, floor or cast-shadow discs.

INPUT ROLES: Both supplied images are ORIGINAL STYLE REFERENCES, not edit targets. Image1 anchors rich tactile sculpted material, irregular rounded thick goo body, eyelids and accessory craftsmanship. Image2 anchors ink-splat morphology and family appeal, NOT its repeated angry grins. Make entirely NEW residents, not veterans, pirates, copies or clothing swaps.

STYLE LOCK / VERY SMALL MATERIAL ADJUSTMENT ONLY: Preserve the same rounded soft modeled stop-motion plasticine/claymation ink language, lovely tactile micro-fingerprints, organic asymmetry and dimensional handworked forms. Nudge body color only slightly toward deeper charcoal-black ink than the references: deep plum remains a subtle undertone, not dominant purple. Keep soft satin reflections and rounded lit volumes, not dead flat black, wet chrome, shiny vinyl, fuzzy felt, coarse grit or fabric weave on the goo. Cloth accessories may retain their own cloth texture. Soft upper-left light, restrained contour highlights. No bright white/lavender rim glow. This is a gentle continuity adjustment, NOT a new style or photoreal liquid material. Offbeat grotesque charming practical clay puppets; avoid generic polished family-animation/Pixar expressions.

ANATOMY: every character one complete upright footless ink blob with rounded droopy splat lobes, little ink hands emerging naturally, no human legs/feet or severed torso. Face/body dominates, sparse simple props only. Sculpted expressive dark lids; every visible eye has clear WHITE/IVORY sclera surrounding RED iris with BLACK pupil. No solid-red eyeballs or glow. Closed mouths have no externally glued teeth; any visible teeth emerge from inside mouth, behind lips. Distinguish all six through silhouette, gaze, mouth, attitude and acting first. Exactly TWO female-read designs (cells1 and6), subtly through styling/lashes; four male-read.

COMPOSITION: Six equal cells, consistent catalogue scale; each full character including droplets/props occupies about85% of cell height with clear safe margins, similar perceived body mass. All upright facing camera, independent and usable alone. No overlap, shared objects, props handed to neighbors, border fragments or cropping. Transparent empty gutters. Each readable at96px. Do not shrink bottom row or leave huge empty margins.

READING ORDER, top-left to bottom-right:
1. SHAME / trying to look normal. Female-read pear-shaped resident, lopsided pinned-up ink quiff, short faded coral neck scarf. Eyes conspicuously glance away while brows lift unevenly; lips squeezed into a small crooked embarrassed line. One ink hand bashfully shields lower cheek, the other clutches an inside-out little knitted mitten. Upright body trying to make itself narrow, still fills the cell. Comic exposed vulnerability, not sad baby cuteness.
2. RELIEF / nearly laughing after a scare. Broad squat male-read resident with two gently flopping crest lobes, small rumpled pale-blue pajama collar only. One hand presses to chest, the other loosely holds an old single house key. Drooping released shoulders, eyelids half open with visible white eyes, mouth in a lopsided breathy relieved toothy exhale, not a screaming O. The tension has just left him.
3. SCHADENFREUDE / delight badly concealed. Small round male-read neighbor with a hook-shaped goo crest, dull olive sleeveless knitted collar. Red irises dart sideways, one brow raised. One hand held over a crumpled smug snicker, a couple of irregular upper teeth visible inside mouth; other hand holds a modest tea cup. Delighted eyes contradict his attempted solemnity. No giant tongue.
4. SAVING FACE / dignity after a minor disaster. Tall narrow male-read resident with drooping loop crest, threadbare burgundy bow tie and one cracked handleless teacup held proudly upright. Chin/lower goo lip lifted, tightly controlled asymmetrical smile, eyes wide with injured dignity and one twitching lid. Other ink hand pats his own bow tie. No mask or literal extra face.
5. COMPULSIVE RULE CERTAINTY / brittle confidence. Blocky-rounded male-read resident, tiny beige domestic cap, little brass-rim reading spectacles BELOW brows so eyes remain readable. Clutches one very small blank folded household rule card against his chest; other hand sternly raises one rounded ink finger. Pursed indignant mouth, one eyebrow rigid and the other betraying anxious doubt. No symbols, writing, giant books, machine anatomy or bureaucratic clutter.
6. RELUCTANT HELPFULNESS / annoyed but caring. Female-read wide crescent-shaped upright blob, short loosely tied mustard headscarf and a single small apron-front patch leaving most goo exposed. Holds a plain little bowl of soup securely to herself, spare spoon tucked in the bowl. One brow scowls and the other lifts with concern; mouth crooked in a resigned closed-lip sigh, gaze attentive toward camera. Clearly capable of kindness while mildly offended by the inconvenience. No matching stock grin or round shouting mouth.

Make the acting broad, visceral, funny and distinct, with the strongest emotional beat frozen in each pose. Absurdity comes from these living ink shapes attempting ordinary human composure, not complicated conceptual machinery. Retain original KFB craft quality and identity while avoiding inherited slot-specific facial formulas.

material_change: Gentle charcoal bias only; no global style overhaul. Purple undertone remains visibly strong, not claimed corrected.
georg_style_decision: Gentle material direction accepted; no stronger correction ordered.
